name: hdstufftodo
description: Static, dependency-free recreation of hdstufftodo.com (published with the owner's permission) for preview on GitHub Pages. The page carries `noindex`, but GitHub Pages is still publicly reachable. The live site and its domain are not touched by this repo.

scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:static && npm run test:dom && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: node --test backend/worker.test.mjs && python3 backend/check-schema.py && node backend/check-bundle.mjs
